content.title: Samsung TriFold, MongoDB, Beyond Meat: Trending stocks
content.description:
Samsung (005930.KS) makes a statement with its new Galaxy Z TriFold smartphone ahead of Apple's (AAPL) expected launch of a foldable model. MongoDB (MDB) Atlas boosts earnings and lifts shares. Marvell (MRVL) Technology is reportedly close to reaching a deal to acquire Celestial AI. Costco (COST) joins the wave of retailers seeking a refund if courts strike down Trump's emergency tariffs. And Beyond Meat (BYND) is on the rise again.

For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.
